summary: Unfold one factor and commute the Weyl law past the higher floors.

steps.lean:
descConv F.floorMeasure (l + 1) i) ∗ₘ heisenbergMeasure l := by rw [descConv, floorMeasure,
  ite_eq_left h, ← mconv_assoc, mconv_comm_of_ae ((ae_descConv_mem ae_floorMeasure_mem).mono fun s k
  ↦ by simp (disch := first | fun_prop | lia) [dirac_mconv, mconv_dirac, Measure.map_map,
  comp_def, floorWeyl, (commute_weylOn _ k).inv_left.eq])]
steps.claim: θ^F_{l+i} ∗ ⋯ ∗ θ^F_l = (θ^F_{l+i} ∗ ⋯ ∗ θ^F_{l+1}) ∗ (weylLaw(l) ∗ η_l) (definitions, l < ϱ); the higher factor is carried by H_{l+1} (ae_descConv_mem), and for s ∈ H_{l+1}, δ_s commutes with weylLaw(l) because w_l(c)⁻¹ commutes with s (commute_weylOn); hence the two commute (mconv_comm_of_ae), and reassociating gives (weylLaw(l) ∗ (θ^F_{l+i} ∗ ⋯ ∗ θ^F_{l+1})) ∗ η_l.
